verdict.rationale: MCP docs show AI can modify/create labels, categorize via custom labels, and answer questions about threads, and a founder's community post explicitly states Zero 'auto-categorizes, summarizes threads, drafts replies' — matching much of the triage story. However there's no explicit evidence of automatic surfacing of 'what needs attention' as a distinct feature, nor documented audit/steering controls beyond manual label editing via MCP tools. missing for 10: dedicated priority/attention-surfacing feature, explicit user-facing controls to steer/override AI triage decisions, and an audit trail of AI actions.
